body:
## Pull request overview

Removes references to non-standard protocol types (`donut`, `geolocation`) to align tests and examples with the canonical Zod schema protocol and fix TypeScript/test failures.

**Changes:**
- Updated dashboard tests and example dashboards to use `type: 'pie'` instead of `type: 'donut'`.
- Removed `Field.geolocation()` factory helper and corresponding tests/reference lists.
- Adjusted a ChartType invalid assertion to use an actually-invalid value.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.test.ts | Removes `donut` from accepted ChartType test cases and updates widget fixture to `pie`. |
| packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts | Removes the `Field.geolocation()` helper to keep factory helpers aligned with the standard FieldType enum. |
| packages/spec/src/data/field.test.ts | Removes `geolocation` from FieldType validity tests and deletes geolocation-specific helper tests. |
| examples/crm/src/ui/dashboards.ts | Updates CRM example dashboard widget from `donut` to `pie` to conform to the protocol. |

The test name says it "should accept all chart types", but this list omits several valid `ChartType` values defined in `dashboard.zod.ts` (e.g. `radar`, `scatter`, `heatmap`, `pivot`, `list`, `image`, `frame`). Consider either deriving the list from the enum (so it stays in sync) or renaming the test to reflect that it only checks a subset.
```suggestion
    const types: string[] = (ChartType as any).options ?? [];
```

Since this PR removes support for `donut`, it would be useful to explicitly assert that `ChartType.parse('donut')` throws in the "reject invalid chart types" test. Right now the test only checks `bubble`/`invalid`, so a future reintroduction of `donut` wouldn’t be caught.
